name: Superior Spider-Man
description: Doctor Octopus has swapped minds with Peter Parker, inheriting Spider-Man's body and powers. Vowing to prove himself the 'superior' Spider-Man, Otto Octavius walks a razor's edge between heroism and tyranny while Peter's ghost fights to reclaim his life.
flavorText: Peter Parker is dead. Long live the Superior Spider-Man.
musicAIPrompt: Create a 45-second seamless loopable orchestral film score in the exact style of John Williams. Mystery / Revelation. Doc Ock in Peter Parker's body as Superior Spider-Man. Twisted heroic theme with mechanical undertones. Identity-twisting and dark, wide stereo, instrumental only, perfectly loopable with no fade in/out.
